text_es: Cuidar un jardín de rosas implica varias tareas para asegurar su floración y salud. La 1.ª tarea es la elección de la ubicación, preferiblemente un lugar soleado que reciba al menos 6 horas de luz directa al día. La 2.ª clave es el riego adecuado, especialmente durante los meses secos, asegurando que el suelo permanezca húmedo pero sin encharcamientos. En 3.º lugar, la poda es fundamental; se realiza generalmente a finales del invierno o principios de primavera para estimular el crecimiento de nuevos brotes y flores, eliminando las ramas secas o dañadas. La 4.ª consideración importante es la fertilización, que debe aplicarse en la época adecuada —alrededor de 3 veces al año— para proporcionar los nutrientes necesarios. En 5.º término, la protección contra plagas y enfermedades es vital, examinando las hojas regularmente para detectar cualquier signo temprano de infestación. Finalmente, la 6.ª y no menos importante recomendación es el acolchado del suelo, que ayuda a retener la humedad y a controlar las malas hierbas.

text_en_raw: Caring for a rose garden involves several tasks to ensure its blooming and health. The 1st task is choosing the location, preferably a sunny spot that receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day. The 2nd key is proper watering, especially during dry months, ensuring the soil remains moist but not waterlogged. In 3rd place, pruning is essential; it's generally done in late winter or early spring to stimulate the growth of new shoots and flowers, removing dry or damaged branches. The 4th important consideration is fertilization, which should be applied at the appropriate time—around 3 times a year—to provide the necessary nutrients. In 5th term, protection against pests and diseases is vital, regularly examining the leaves to detect any early sign of infestation. Finally, the 6th and no less important recommendation is mulching the soil, which helps retain moisture and control weeds.

text_en_raw: To cultivate a rose garden, 1st, select a sunny spot where they receive at least 6 hours of direct light a day. The 2nd fundamental step is to prepare the soil with abundant organic matter to ensure good drainage and nutrition. 3rd, water your rose bushes deeply and regularly, especially during dry periods, avoiding wetting the leaves to prevent diseases. The 4th crucial aspect is pruning: perform a light prune in summer and a more severe one in winter to encourage growth and flowering. As a 5th tip, inspect your plants frequently to detect pests and diseases in time, acting quickly. The 6th important point is to fertilize every 4 to 6 weeks during the growing season with a specific rose fertilizer. And 7th, don't forget to remove withered flowers to stimulate new blooms.

text_en_raw: Learning to ski is a rewarding experience that requires patience and dedication. The 1st step is to familiarize yourself with the equipment: boots, skis, and poles. Afterward, in 2nd place, it's crucial to understand basic techniques like the wedge for braking and turning. The 3rd phase involves going up to green slopes, the easiest ones, and practicing descents. It's normal to fall at first; in fact, some don't make it on the 4th try, but persistence is key. The 5th tip is to take lessons with a qualified instructor to correct common mistakes from the beginning and, in 6th place, to learn how to use the ski lifts safely. Progression is usually gradual, and by the 7th day many already feel comfortable on blue slopes.

En 2.º lugar, invierte o alquila un buen equipo: botas cómodas, esquís adecuados a tu altura y bastones; un buen ajuste marca la diferencia. El 3.º consejo es empezar en pistas verdes, las más fáciles, para familiarizarte con el deslizamiento y las caídas sin peligro. La proporción habitual es de 1 kg de fresas por 500 g a 700 g de azúcar, aunque el 4.º punto es ajustar esto al dulzor de la fruta. Se mezclan las fresas y el azúcar en una olla y se dejan reposar durante al menos 1 hora para que suelten sus jugos, siendo esta una parte fundamental para el 5.º paso, que es la cocción. Se lleva a ebullición a fuego medio, removiendo constantemente para evitar que se pegue, lo que representa la 6.ª fase. La cocción debe continuar hasta que la mermelada espese y alcance el punto deseado, lo cual puede tardar entre 20 y 30 minutos. Tras ello, la 7.ª etapa es verterla caliente en tarros esterilizados y sellarlos herméticamente para su conservación.

text_en_raw: Choosing the right running shoes is crucial for preventing injuries and improving performance. The 1st step is to know your foot strike type: if you're a pronator, supinator, or neutral. For the 2nd, consider the terrain where you'll be running, whether it's asphalt, track, or trail, as each requires a specific type of cushioning and sole. The 3rd tip is not to focus solely on price or brand, but on comfort and fit. The 4th key is to try on shoes at the end of the day, when your feet are most swollen, and to wear your usual running socks. A 5th important aspect is cushioning; you have to choose one that adapts to your weight and distance traveled. As a 6th point, don't get carried away by aesthetics; functionality is paramount. Finally, a 7th tip is to replace your shoes every 600 to 800 kilometers, or sooner if you notice they've lost their properties.

text_es: Hacer un mapa del barrio es una actividad didáctica y útil que permite a los participantes conocer mejor su entorno. Si se trata de un proyecto escolar, la 6.ª etapa a menudo involucra la presentación final a la clase, mientras que una 7.ª versión podría ser publicada para la comunidad. text_en_raw: Making a neighborhood map is a didactic and useful activity that allows participants to better understand their environment. The 1st step consists of identifying the geographical limits of the area to be represented, whether it's a few blocks or an entire district. In 2nd place, the main points of interest should be indicated, such as parks, stores, schools, or health centers. The 3rd phase involves deciding what additional information will be included, for example, public transportation routes or pedestrian zones. It's crucial to perform several revisions; the 4th revision could focus on the clarity of the symbols and the 5th on the accuracy of the locations. If it's a school project, the 6th stage often involves the final presentation to the class, while a 7th version could be published for the community. This process encourages observation and teamwork, offering a unique perspective of the place where one lives.

Finally, my 7th and last step was to draw the secret routes that only us kids knew.
